QUOTE: "the repository's own `index_scope:` declaration in `.clew.yaml` decides. If there isn't a usable one, the whole repository is the scope" and "Two cases fall through to the whole repository. One is a rejected section... The other is a section where no root exists."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the declared index_scope is preferred and that rejected, missing, or no-roots cases all fall through to whole-repo indexing.
